title: Conditional centering empties the margin-certified stable branch
statement: For d_psi = d_lambda = 1 and any atomless law in class (L) (E[S_lambda | shat] = 0 a.s.) with E S = 0, E||S||^2 < oo, and I > 0: (POPULATION) every root-consistent strip rule, meaning E[h(T_beta) S_lambda] = 0, has binned nuisance block exactly zero at every tilt and K >= 2; equivalently, no regular tilt-consistent strip rule B*(I_q) = beta exists because that definition requires I_lambdalambda(q) > 0. Hence no full-rank bounded-packet stationary rule has pairwise-distinct projected centroids. (EMPIRICAL) if (M4) also holds, the pathwise audited DS14 bridge gives one selection-independent probability-one event on which, for fixed K and every rational kappa, c_0, gamma > 0, all sufficiently large N have no ordinary one-point exchange-stable K-cell labeling satisfying (M2)+(M3)+(M5). Neither (S) nor (R) is used. Thus OP30(a) full-triple inhabitation is disproved on this conditionally centered class; the conclusion does not extend to non-centered laws.
assumptions: d_psi = d_lambda = 1; K >= 2 for the population statement, K >= 3 for margin nonvacuity (centered-sample cardinality, commit 891bbf3)
(L) is the population condition E[S_lambda | shat] = 0 a.s.; it is not sample centering and does not permit recentering score rows
atomless P; E S = 0; E||S||^2 < oo; full I > 0; (M4) uniform slab margin only for the empirical chain (automatic for atomless elliptical laws with nonsingular scatter)

(S) and (R) are NOT assumed; the empirical chain imports DS14 (OPEN-DS-FINITE-POP-BRIDGE) with its audited hypotheses, restated pathwise via the fixed-class uniform-law events (DS17.0), and the DS14 Step-4 identification (not bare DS12) to exclude coincident projected centroids under (M5)
i.i.d. equal weights; exact scores (estimated scores are P2); ordinary one-point exchange stability, never stability-under-constraint
regular tilt consistency B*(I_q) = beta is used only when I_lambdalambda(q) > 0; at a singular nuisance block only the numerator/root equation is defined
the disproof concerns the full margin triple (M2)+(M3)+(M5); dropping (M5) the merged branch survives and is classified by DS-STABLE-BASINS-LCM-CLASSIFICATION

proof_location.section: DS17. Inhabitation of the margin-certified branch: the conditional-centering obstruction and the fixed-point gate

role: resolves OP30(a) on the packet's class: the strongest form of the DS15/DS16 degeneracy - the certified branch is not merely priced but eventually empty
warning: Audit-hardened. The theorem is only about population conditional centering (L), not sample-centered scores and not the general template/HEP model class. Off (L), one measured mix3 root has negligible price, but no general free-certification claim follows. Finite N <= 14 atomic witnesses are pre-asymptotic; N_0(omega) is finite but not uniform.
